incidents.desc: Check up happens before the start, the #101 car runs into the #33 and the #101 car spins on the track, the #12 is involved.
The #25 car moves a little bit up the track and the  #28 car runs into the #25.  The #28 car then gets into the wall.
incidents.ruling: Racing Incident, while the #25 made a slight initial error the #28 failed to make room and protect their own car.

incidents.desc: The #12 just fails to avoid the #787, there was no contention leading up to this
incidents.ruling: #12 is at fault, you need to be aware where other cars are on the track, you cannot run through someone because you're having a good run off the corner.

incidents.desc: Car #12 gets loose exiting pit road and hits the wall.  A caution is brought out.
Car #787 hits the wall and comes back down the track and hits the #92
incidents.ruling: Racing incident, #787 is at fault however this is accidental, practice your high lines.

incidents.desc: The #08 car gets loose and shows us a cool burn out
incidents.ruling: Racing Incident stop watching Tokyo Drift

incidents.desc: Car #14 gets loose on the restart and bounces off the #11 car into the left lane.  The #99 car is collected
incidents.ruling: The #14 car is at fault due to throttle control

incidents.desc: The #08 comes from the inside and pit maneuvers the #14
incidents.ruling: The #08 is at fault, be vigilant about scanning for cars in your peripheral

incidents.desc: The #90 car comes up the track  and clips the #2
incidents.ruling: The number #90 is at fault however not intentional this is a racing incident

incidents.desc: The #13 car gets loose, throttles up and hits the wall
incidents.ruling: Car #13 states his wheel had a tantrum, racing incident

incidents.desc: Car #11 is driving next to car #57 and turns him.
incidents.ruling: Warning.  Car #11 admitted in chat they were attempting to side draft the #57 however when attempting moves like this you need to have the car control to support such actions.

incidents.desc: The #14 car self spins under caution and hits the wall
The #15 was aggressive going door to door with the #25 and the #25 held his line causing the #15 to spin
